name: Greek hold 'em
summary: A poker variant where players must make a hand using both hole cards and exactly three community cards.
rules_text: Each player is dealt two private hole cards and there is a board of five community cards dealt in stages with betting rounds between. At showdown each remaining player must form the best five-card poker hand using exactly both of their hole cards combined with exactly three cards from the board. The highest standard poker hand wins the pot. Betting, folding, calling and raising follow the same structure as Texas hold 'em and Omaha. If all but one player folds, the last player wins without showdown.
rating_reason: Specific community-card poker, hidden info bluffing
